text:
vivian-marketing: Quick creative brief for the webinar + benchmark push — need a compact "econ snap" pack we can reuse across socials and the LP. Deliverables (priority order):
1) One-page benchmark narrative (printable PNG + fig) that explains cost vs latency tradeoffs
2) 3 social tiles (square, landscape hero, story) with A/B headline variants
3) A simple cost-vs-latency Venn/2x2 visual for the slide deck
4) Inbound routing microdiagram (CTA -> LP -> nurture -> SDR) with UTM example and email subject suggestions
5) Localization notes (EN/FR/DE) — keep text blocks short

Deadline: first comps in 72 hours. Tone: engineer-forward, concise, trust-building. Full logo lockup on hero; stacked ok on small tiles.

omar-design: Got it. Two quick questions: which headline family should we favor for hero vs tiles? and do we need legal footer? Also do we want numeric callouts (e.g., $/k tokens) or keep fuzzy descriptions?

vivian-marketing: Hero headline: "Serve inference reliably. Pay predictably." Tile headline variants for A/B: "Ship LLM features, not surprises" and "Predictable inference, lower unit cost". Include one numeric callout example on the benchmark one-pager (illustrative only) and add tiny legal footer: "Illustrative metrics; actual usage may vary."

kat-motion: I can do motion-friendly frames for the story + a 4s hero loop. Will keep layers named for export. Will provide PNG keyframes + a short MP4. If we want a web fallback, I can produce a Lottie JSON.

lucas-growth: For routing microdiagram, UTM suggestion: `?utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=econ_snap_launch_v1`. Suggested CTAs: "Watch demo & grab credits" / "See predictable inference in action". Subject lines to A/B test: (A) "Live demo: cut inference surprises" (B) "How to make LLM serving predictable".

omar-design: Color token pass (testing AA):
```
--rdw-primary-700: #0b3d91
--rdw-primary-500: #3461d3
--rdw-accent-400: #ffb547
--rdw-text-900: #0b0b0b
```
I'll produce a high-contrast alt palette and an accessible pairing table. Also will size artboards to mobile-first dimensions.

design-bot: EXPORT CHECKLIST: Include Figma link, artboards: 1080x1080, 1200x628, 1080x1920, 1920x1080. Deliverables: PNG-1x, PNG-2x, MP4 (story), layered .fig, PDF one-pager, color tokens, font files, and AA-accessible color variants. Ensure logo lockups: full lockup on hero, stacked on tiles. Add tiny legal footer to one-pager. (automated)

omar-design: I'll push two visual directions into Figma today — "Data-first" (sparklines + numeric callouts) and "System-first" (icons, infrastructure metaphors). Tagging @kat-motion for layer sync. ETA: first frames in ~48h.

vivian-marketing: Perfect. Prioritize the one-pager + routing microdiagram, then tiles and motion frames. Quick sync tomorrow 11am PT to review initial comps. Thanks :sparkles:
